# Follow the Tracks

*This time Bekk goes with leave, and with you. Follow the raider's tracks over the Hot Rocks (three places) and clear 80 Iron Boars from the way.*

|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the tracks on the long flat in [The Hot Rocks](../maps/hot_rocks.md)
2. Look at the tracks on the high rock in [The Hot Rocks](../maps/hot_rocks.md)
3. Look at the tracks toward the mesa in [The Hot Rocks](../maps/hot_rocks.md)
4. Defeat 80 [Iron Boar](../monsters/iron_boar.md) in [The Hot Rocks](../maps/hot_rocks.md)

## Rewards

- 62,000 EXP
- 920 mesos
- [Trail Watch Boots](../items/trail_watch_boots.md) x1
- [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x10
- +40 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md)
